Name: Weight of Binding
Description: You summon great golden chains to fully bind those that must be held down, guaranteeing no escape. You target a creature within a reach and it must pass a Strength Saving Throw or golden chains burst out of thin air and constrict around them. That creature becomes Grappled for the next minute and suffers 2d8 bludgeoning damage at the end of their turns while grappled. A creature bound by this may perform an Athletics check against your Spell Save DC to free themselves at the end of their turn after suffering the spell's damage.
